new:
let target_humanoid_usable = manifest
        .iter()
        .find_map(|(_, entry)| {
            entry
                .import_settings
                .skeleton_records
                .iter()
                .find(|record| record.id == target_skeleton.as_str())
                .map(|record| {
                    entry
                        .import_settings
                        .humanoid_profiles
                        .iter()
                        .any(|profile| profile.is_structurally_usable_with_record(record))
                })
        })
        .unwrap_or(false);
